recipes.title: pizza
recipes.instructions:
Ingredients (basic):

Pizza dough

Tomato sauce

Cheese (mozzarella)

Toppings (pepperoni, vegetables, etc.)

Olive oil

Steps

Preheat Oven

Preheat your oven to 220°C (425°F).

Prepare Dough

Divide dough into portions (for standard 12-inch pizzas, ~250g per portion).

Lightly flour your workspace.

Shape the Dough

Flatten each portion with your hands or rolling pin.

Make a small edge for the crust.

Add Sauce

Spread tomato sauce evenly on the dough, leaving the edge free.

Add Cheese

Sprinkle grated mozzarella generously over the sauce.

Add Toppings

Place your toppings evenly (pepperoni, veggies, mushrooms, etc.).

Drizzle Oil (Optional)

Lightly drizzle olive oil for extra flavor.

Bake the Pizza

Place pizza in the preheated oven.

Bake for 12–15 minutes until crust is golden and cheese is melted.

Check & Remove

Make sure the crust is cooked and cheese is bubbling.

Remove pizza from oven using a pizza peel or baking tray.

Cool Slightly & Slice

Let pizza cool for 2–3 minutes.

Slice into portions and serve.

recipes.title: chicken curry
recipes.instructions:
🧺 Ingredients

500g chicken (cut into pieces)

1 onion (chopped)

2 tomatoes (blended or chopped)

2 tablespoons cooking oil

2 cloves garlic (crushed)

1 teaspoon ginger (optional)

1 teaspoon curry powder

½ teaspoon turmeric

Salt (to taste)

1 cup water

Fresh coriander (optional)

👩‍🍳 Steps
Step 1: Heat oil

Put a pot on medium heat

Add oil and let it warm

Step 2: Cook onions

Add onions

Cook until soft and slightly brown

Step 3: Add garlic & ginger

Add garlic and ginger

Stir for 30 seconds until fragrant

Step 4: Add spices

Add curry powder, turmeric, and salt

Stir for 1 minute

Step 5: Add tomatoes

Add tomatoes

Cook until oil separates from the sauce (about 5 minutes)

Step 6: Add chicken

Add chicken pieces

Stir to coat with sauce

Cook for 5 minutes

Step 7: Add water

Add water

Cover and simmer for 20–25 minutes

Step 8: Finish

Taste and adjust salt

Garnish with coriander

🍽 Serve With

Rice

Chapati

Spaghetti

recipes.title: black forest cake
recipes.instructions:
🧺 Ingredients
Chocolate Cake

1½ cups all-purpose flour

1 cup sugar

½ cup cocoa powder

1 teaspoon baking powder

½ teaspoon baking soda

2 eggs

1 cup milk

½ cup vegetable oil or melted butter

1 teaspoon vanilla essence

Filling & Topping

Whipping cream (cold)

Powdered sugar (to taste)

Cherries (fresh or canned)

Chocolate shavings

👩‍🍳 Steps
Step 1: Preheat oven

Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F)

Grease and flour a cake pan

Step 2: Mix dry ingredients

In a bowl mix:

flour

sugar

cocoa powder

baking powder

baking soda

Step 3: Add wet ingredients

Add:

eggs

milk

oil/butter

vanilla

Mix until smooth (don’t overmix).

Step 4: Bake

Pour batter into pan

Bake for 30–35 minutes

Let cake cool completely

🍒 Filling & Decoration
Step 5: Whip cream

Beat cold whipping cream

Add powdered sugar

Beat until soft peaks form

Step 6: Slice cake

Cut cake horizontally into 2 or 3 layers

Step 7: Assemble

Spread whipped cream on first layer

Add cherries

Place next layer and repeat

Step 8: Final decoration

Cover whole cake with whipped cream

Sprinkle chocolate shavings

Add cherries on top 🍒

🍽 Tips

Chill cake for 1–2 hours before serving

Use cherry syrup to keep cake moist

recipes.title: burger
recipes.instructions:
🧺 Ingredients
Burger Patty

500g minced beef (or chicken)

1 small onion (finely chopped)

1 egg

1 teaspoon salt

½ teaspoon black pepper

1 teaspoon garlic powder (optional)

Burger Assembly

Burger buns

Lettuce

Tomato slices

Cheese slices

Ketchup / mayonnaise

Cooking oil

👩‍🍳 Steps
Step 1: Make the patty

Put minced meat in a bowl

Add onion, egg, salt, pepper, garlic powder

Mix well

Step 2: Shape patties

Divide mixture into round flat patties

Don’t make them too thick

Step 3: Cook patties

Heat oil in a pan (medium heat)

Cook patties 3–5 minutes per side

Add cheese on top during last minute (optional)

Step 4: Toast buns

Lightly toast burger buns in a pan or oven

Step 5: Assemble burger

Bottom bun → sauce → lettuce → patty → tomato → cheese → sauce → top bun

🍽 Serve With

Fries 🍟

Coleslaw

Cold drink 🥤
